Street address of Union Station, Washington, DC

## ANSWER
Union Station in Washington, DC is at 50 Massachusetts Avenue NE, Washington, DC 20002. [c1] Amtrak's station page gives the longer ZIP code 20002-4214. [c1] The station's own contact page says the same thing. [c1] The pages I found do not state an effective date for the address. Street addresses rarely change, so I treat it as current. [c1]
